description: A project's hard rules: short never/always rules from the user, shown first in every brief and never cut. add: when the user states one (one sentence, max 300 chars; 25 rules, 2,000 chars in total); it waits in the review queue until the user approves it themselves (on their review page; no app can). list: active rules. remove: ONLY when the user asks in this chat; quote them in user_request; it waits like add; the rule is kept as removed. Preferences and lessons go in log_work. Requires project. Returns the rule or {rules}.

action.description: The operation; see the tool description.

model.description: Model name if known. Never guess.

rule.description: add: the rule, one short sentence.

rule_id.description: remove: the rule's id (R<id> in the brief).

user_request.description: remove (required): the user's own words asking to remove it.

name: manage_rules
